gates.name: Official provenance
gates.rule: Every input value has an official source URL; unverifiable values blank + flagged.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Strategy specification frozen in the repository before any evaluation.

gates.name: No look-ahead
gates.rule: Only official data strictly earlier than the game date may be used.

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.rule: A strategy needs at least 200 graded, independent observations.

gates.name: Chronological out-of-sample holdout
gates.rule: At least 30% of observations held out chronologically, with >= 100 holdout observations.

gates.name: Significance after multiple-testing control
gates.rule: Two-sided p < 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the strategy family.

gates.name: Luck removal / effect size
gates.rule: 95% Wilson lower bound on accuracy must exceed the chance baseline, and a permutation test must reject the luck null.

gates.name: Family-wise dependence control
gates.rule: All tested signals entered into one pre-declared family; parlay legs screened with a measured correlation and CI.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.rule: Results regenerate identically from checked-in official data + code; site has no broken links.

gates.name: Market-independent verification
gates.rule: An official closing line must exist to compute closing-line value; no official source publishes odds.

findings.finding: All 30 official 2026-27 standings rows and all 30 official team-stat rows were transcribed from NBA.com and are reproduced here with per-row official links.
A 56-game official final-score sample across six dates (2026-10-21 to 2026-11-01) is the largest verified dataset available; 10 of the 56 games are NBA Cup group-play games (I-14).

Numeric correlation coefficients ARE computable from official inputs. The strongest relationship with winning percentage is reported with r, p, 95% CI and BH-FDR q on the Correlations page. These are derived in-sample descriptive statistics, not official publications and not predictive skill (I-13).

The NBA Stats FAQ itself publishes an official illustrative correlation: team PIE rating and winning percentage correlate at R-squared .908. It is historical FAQ context, not a 2026-27 measurement or a betting signal.

Own4 fair lines for the 15 official 2026-11-02 games were originated from official +/- ratings and official per-game scoring averages, with a margin dispersion estimated from official results. No market price was copied or inferred (I-12).
Cross-game margin correlation was measured from official results and is reported with a confidence interval, so parlay independence is treated as an assumption to test rather than a fact.

Same-player prop legs are not independent: PPG/RPG, PPG/APG and RPG/APG correlations across the 30 official season leaders are reported. A correlation-adjusted joint price is left blank because no official source publishes the joint distribution.

A strictly walk-forward backtest (only prior-date official scores) graded 38 of 56 games. Winner accuracy 0.6053 (95% Wilson CI [0.447, 0.744]) with exact binomial p=0.2559 and permutation p=0.1268: chance cannot be excluded.

No strategy passes all ten validation gates. Sample-size, luck-removal and market-independent-verification gates fail, so the leaderboard awards zero rewards. This is the intended 'remove luck / selectively skill-based' outcome: no strategy is promoted on a short, noisy sample.

The merged site from earlier sessions was re-audited line by line. Verified claims were retained; stale links, a source/claim mismatch, imprecise wording, an image-only statistic, an outdated helpline number and a conflicting official score are published on the Flagged for Review page.

The NBA Stats FAQ restricts downloading statistics for academic or personal use. This project used no automated download or scraping; values were read from displayed pages and each row links back to the official page for manual review (I-08).
